translations.web: What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.
translations.bsb: What I tell you in the dark, speak in the daylight; what is whispered in your ear, proclaim from the housetops.
translations.kjv: What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops.
translations.asv: What I tell you in the darkness, speak ye in the light; and what ye hear in the ear, proclaim upon the house-tops.
